title: Alpha association before image interpolation
verification_method: Original specification reading and independent paper arithmetic; no image-processing or GPU execution.

sources.author: The Khronos Group; editors Daniel Rice and Robert J. Simpson
sources.title: OpenVG Specification Version 1.1 Revision 1
sources.locator: Section 3.4.3, printed page 23; Section 10.8 vgDrawImage, printed page 150
sources.read_scope: Title/date, alpha association definition, image interpolation and its image-color-space qualification; not the entire specification.
sources.supports: This API specifies premultiplied image interpolation. It does not establish behavior for arbitrary game engines or assert every image uses a linear-light format.

sources.author: Thomas Porter and Tom Duff
sources.title: Compositing Digital Images
sources.read_scope: Full extracted paper text; figures are not used as independently verified visual evidence.
sources.supports: Associated color representation and compositing arithmetic. The two-texel filtering example is an editorial derivation, not an example attributed to this paper.

editorial_derivation.inputs: Straight RGBA red (1,0,0,1) and transparent blue (0,0,1,0), equal positive weights, one linear RGB working space, ordinary non-emissive colors.
editorial_derivation.limits: Ideal arithmetic only. No GPU, browser, texture import, mip generation, compression, atlas, visual quality or performance result. Specific equal-color or equal-alpha inputs can make the orders coincide.
